scope: Bounded primary-source search, public repositories and institutional records. This is not an exhaustive global search.
queries: high voltage impulse generator waveform dataset switching lightning Zenodo
high voltage impulse raw voltage/time waveforms
positive leader branching switching impulse dataset
benchmark_eligibility_rule: Need independently observed unchopped LI and SI targets plus complete known inputs for stages, stage capacitance, charge, front/tail resistors, load/divider/stray capacitance and inductance. Neither units nor circuit parameters may be invented.
result: No reviewed source is eligible to establish six-output final-test improvement. Two small trusted external numeric files were downloaded, byte verified and quarantined from training.

candidates.title: Dataset for Linearity Extension of UHV Class Lightning Impulse Dividers up to 3000 kV
candidates.review: Workbook sheets Info, Fig. 3, Fig. 4, Fig. 6, Fig. 7, Fig. 8, Fig. 9. Impulse calibration errors, normalized divider comparisons and slow charging traces. No raw impulse traces or complete per-shot generator inputs. Reference context only.

candidates.title: Observation and statistical analysis data for positive leader branching in long air gaps
candidates.units_status: not_verified: CSV has no header; do not silently assign units
candidates.review: Downloaded Figure 2 voltage data, linked in the article availability statement. One trace; 9987 rows. Numeric time column -39.124 to 360.32, spacing about 0.04; signal peak 847.86 at 93.316. Sharp decay requires chopped/breakdown review. No stages, stage capacitance, Rf, Rt, charging setting or load/parasitic circuit mapping per shot. Preserve as external waveform audit material, not six-target labels.

candidates.title: Characteristics of Impulse-driven Surface Flashover across Polymers with Different Surface Conditions
candidates.download_status: 403 Forbidden via browser fetch and direct public URL; no bypass attempted
candidates.raw_voltage_time_capture: repository reports 1600 CSV sets, content uninspected
candidates.review: 20 ns stacked-Blumlein and approximately 100 us Samtech trigger-generator waveforms; voltage/current breakdown studies. Different generators and waveform families; no compatible six-output setup mapping established.

candidates.title: The Breakdown and Surface Characteristics of Polymer Interfaces Under HV Impulses
candidates.raw_voltage_time_capture: repository reports 800 CSV sets, content uninspected
candidates.review: Breakdown on rising slope, not complete unchopped LI/SI generator responses; different rates of rise. Not downloaded because target/setup compatibility was not established.

candidates.title: Photonic Voltage Transducer with Lightning Impulse Protection for Distributed Monitoring of MV Networks
candidates.review: A 4.93 kB sensor accuracy calibration file; title references LI protection, but no raw multi-setting LI/SI generator dataset established.

candidates.title: Real Electronic Signal Data from Particle Accelerator Power Systems for Machine Learning Anomaly Detection
candidates.publisher: Mendeley Data; Oak Ridge SNS facility researchers
candidates.review: Real high-voltage converter modulator traces; accelerator pulsed-power anomaly detection, not LI/SI impulse-generator shape prediction. Domain mismatch.

candidates.title: Using deconvolution for correction of non-ideal step response of lightning impulse digitizers and measurement systems
candidates.review: Repository supplies paper PDF only. Useful signal-processing reference; not numeric training observations.

candidates.title: Reference Calibrator for Combined and Composite High Voltage Impulse Tests
candidates.review: Paper on sub-1 kV calibrator and waveform generation; repository did not establish downloadable per-shot generator-setting data.

candidates.title: Single level impulse generator
candidates.publisher: Mendeley Data; Suman Jana, National Institute of Technology Mizoram
candidates.raw_voltage_time_capture: described but numeric file not retrieved
candidates.review: Primary description explicitly identifies numerical simulation, one single-level Lightning generator and a 4.2MV crest. Complete circuit/setup parameters and paired LI/SI outputs are not supplied by the inspected description. Not measured data; cannot repair the supplied final-test benchmark.

additional_metrology_review: docs/reference_waveform_data_review.md; DOI10.5281/zenodo.6340016 measured step responses are independent acquisition-negative controls, not generator-output labels.
limits: Bounded search; no matching six-output input-setting dataset was identified. All downloads remain quarantined from model fitting. Unknown CSV units were not guessed. Download failures are retained; no paid sources were purchased or access controls bypassed.
